description: SDMX library  .A common library and programming API for working with SDMX data and structural metadata. This is a port from Java of Eurostat's fork of Metadata Technologies SdmxSource v1.1.4.
releaseNotes:
# Changelog

## sdmxsource.net v10.14.0 (2026-05-29)

### Details v10.14.0

1. Add support for JSON reader,writer for vaious structures

### Tickets v10.14.0

The following new features added:

- SDMXRI-2908 SdmxSource .NET ValueList JSON 2.0.0 reader
- SDMXRI-2909 SdmxSource .NET ValueList JSON 2.0.0 writer
- SDMXRI-2918 SdmxSource .NET Hierarchy JSON 2.0.0 reader
- SDMXRI-2920 SdmxSource .NET HierarchyAssociation JSON 2.0.0 writer
- SDMXRI-2922 SdmxSource .NET HierarchyAssociation JSON 2.0.0 reader


## sdmxsource.net v10.13.0 (2026-04-24)

### Details v10.13.0

1. Migration to .Net 10
1. Implemented reader/writer for artefact RepresentationMap

### Tickets v10.13.0

The following new features added:

- SDMXRI-2906 Migrate to .NET 10
- SDMXRI-2912 SdmxSource .NET RepresentationMap JSON 2.0.0 writer
- SDMXRI-2914 SdmxSource .NET RepresentationMap .JSON 2.0.0 reader
- SDMXRI-2954 Registry v2 Query with JSON_V20 output as default format problem .NET

The following bugs have been corrected:

- SDMXRI-2957 Investigate performance regression NSIWS 10.11.x (.NET)

## sdmxsource.net v10.12.0 (2026-03-09)

### Details v10.12.0

1. Various bug fixers.
1. Implemented retrieve/persist for artefact MetadataProviderScheme

### Tickets v10.12.0

The following new features added:

- SDMXRI-2716 - SDMXRI.NET retrieve/persist MetadataProviderScheme

The following bugs have been corrected:

- SDMXRI-2725 - SDMX-RI.NET - error about invalid xml because of pattern for parent code with SDMX 3.0 structure
- SDMXRI-2872 - Available constraint wrong endPeriod
- SDMXRI-2880 - Server error on retrieval of sdmx 3.0 structure with SDMX 2.1 endpoint + detail=allcompletestubs
- SDMXRI-2881 - Annotations on hierarchical codelists are not stored
- SDMXRI-2901 - Remove redundant loop for efficiency reasons
- SDMXRI-2905 - XML writer throws an exception when written string value has invalid characters (ascii bellow 20, except TAB,LF,NL)

## sdmxsource.net v10.11.0 (2026-01-29)

### Details v10.11.0

1. Updated support for wildcarded version queries
1. Implemented retrieve/persist for a new artefact Process
1. Fixed bug for dataflow SDMX 3.0 non updating final status

### Tickets v10.11.0

The following new features added:

- SDMXRI-2705: Update SDMX REST 2.1 query for all versions .NET
- SDMXRI-2825: Extended Process metadata retrieve/persist (.net)

The following bugs have been corrected:

- SDMXRI-2863: SDMXRI minor issues found in v10.10.0-(2025-12-01)

## sdmxsource.net v10.10.2 (2025-12-22)

### Details v10.10.2

1. Code clean up from NL-CBS
1. Support for extended Process artefact. (SDMX-JSON format). Note this Process artefact is an extension to the SDMX standard
1. Bug fixes:
   1. Improve Dataflow update compatibility check, ensure that wildcards are considered and version extension is ignored.
   1. Handle corner case with Time period not being last

### Tickets v10.10.2

The following new features added:

- SDMXRI-2857: Cleanup Sdmxsource.net
- SDMXRI-2823: Extended Process metadata beans/reader/writers  SDMX-JSON 2 (.net) (Metadata,ProcessMetadata,SDMX-JSON-2)

The following bugs have been corrected:

- SDMXRI-2863: SDMXRI minor issues found in v10.10.0-(2025-12-01)
- SDMXRI-2873: JSON 2.0 writer misbehaves when TimeDimension in DB not on the last position

## sdmxsource.net v10.10.1 (2025-12-16)

### Details v10.10.1

1. Fix end period in available constraints

### Tickets v10.10.1

The following bugs have been corrected:

- SDMXRI-2872: Available constraint wrong endPeriod

### Tickets v10.10.0
